description: Find the fix guide for an error message from an app built with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, v0 or Supabase. Pass the exact error text (a log line, a console message, an HTTP error body). Returns the best matching guides with their links; then call get_guide with a slug for the full fix.

error.description: The exact error text, as shown (up to 4000 characters).

name: lookup_error
title: Look up an error
